notice: Data model of the habitat simulated twin. Recorded NASA values are replayed where they fit; the fault scenarios are fault injection, not measurements, and say so. No value here is a clinical threshold.

dose_rate.note: RadLab DosTel1, Columbus module, 1 to 2 Apr 2022; an instrument dose rate, never a person's dose.

sound_level.note: ICES-2024-354 U.S. Lab spatial average, nasa-data/acoustics/iss_acoustic_levels.csv line 2. A spot value with no time series: held constant, no variation added.

nominal.basis: Recorded NASA telemetry replayed unchanged (N02, N20, N32).

co2_rise_iss_2001_2009.pressure_basis: NASA-SOURCES.md section 2 states the 760 mmHg assumption used to convert ppm and mmHg (N02).
co2_rise_iss_2001_2009.basis: Levels are the printed values of NASA/TP-2010-216126 as transcribed in the case CSV: line 2 (STS-112, 2.7 mm Hg), line 4 (Expedition 6, above 4 mm Hg and relief to about 2 mm Hg), line 3 (STS-113, up to 7.5 mm Hg). The case is qualitative (outcome.json line 3): only spot values and peaks are printed, so the ramp and hold lengths are a shape, not a recorded time series.

spe_2017_09.basis: Recorded DosTel2 rows (Columbus module) around the September 2017 solar particle event. The event began at 16:06 UTC on 10 September and first reached the ISS about 04:30 UTC on 11 September (outcome.json lines 20 and 62, Berger et al. 2018). The window starts before the onset and ends after the elevated passes. Timestamps carry no zone in the API.

motion_noise.basis: Fault injection: periodic spikes standing for motion or electrical noise. Parameters are test mechanism, not a measurement.

low_signal.basis: Fault injection: a weak link drops every third notification and reports a low RSSI. Missing notifications stay missing.

disconnect.basis: Fault injection: the link is lost after five notifications.

drift.basis: Fault injection: a calibration drift of a fixed raw count per sample.

out_of_range.basis: Fault injection: a physically implausible value inside the encoding's range.

stuck.basis: Fault injection: the sensor repeats its last value.

saturation.basis: Fault injection: the sensor reports its encoding's saturation code, which the protocol defines as at or above the range.

not_known.basis: Fault injection: the sensor reports its 'value is not known' code.
